fields: h, intro, items [{t, d, hold, link, sheet}]. sheet (optional): the drawing level, one of matrix, route, pid, iso, freeze, joints (default: that order by position).
best_for: FidelityLadder shows design stages as one drawing gaining detail on a navy blueprint band: every stage is a sheet with the same water package drawn at that stage's level (matrix, block route, P&ID, dimensioned isometric, frozen isometric, spools with their joints), joined by a run with a node per stage and a closed valve and "Hold point" stamp where you sign.

Approved P&IDs, isometrics, design specifications and the commissioning and qualification plan.
Reviewed against every URS line. Your quality unit approves DQ; later changes go through change control.
The factory and site acceptance tests (FAT, SAT) follow the approved specification.
